data.text: Under stress, EBITDA falls to $70M and free cash flow falls to $10M. Refinancing at 10% raises annual interest to $40M.
The 5.00x maximum leverage and 2.00x minimum coverage rules both fail under this scenario: leverage is 5.71x and coverage is 1.75x.
Pizza Co. still produces positive cash flow, and the stress case could prove temporary.
The borrower breaches both covenants with limited liquidity before the 2028 maturity. We should not lend.
The covenant breaches outweigh the remaining cash generation. The committee recommends not lending.
Don't lend — the stressed case breaches both loan rules.
